core.name: Jägersro
core.why: Sweden's only combined trot and gallop track, a large landmark that names a whole district and a common reference point in eastern Malmö.

core.name: Eleda Stadion
core.why: Malmö FF's home arena (formerly Swedbank Stadion), the city's football stadium and the most-viewed article in the category.

core.name: Malmö Arena
core.why: The big indoor arena at Hyllie (Redhawks, Eurovision 2013/2024), next to Hyllie station and a standard reference point there.

core.name: Baltiska Hallen
core.why: The 1964 sports and event hall on Stadionområdet with the Idrottsmuseet, long the home of handball in Malmö.

core.name: Malmö Isstadion
core.why: The 1968 ice stadium on Stadionområdet, Redhawks' old home and Eurovision 1992 venue, still in use (IK Pantern).

core.name: Malmö Idrottsplats
core.why: 'Gamla idrottsplatsen' from 1896 by Pildammsparken/Fersens väg, a central, historic venue everyone passes.

core.name: Stapelbäddsparken
core.why: The concrete skatepark and STPLN culture house in Västra hamnen, a well-known feature of the waterfront since 2005/06.

missing.name: Zlatan Court
missing.why: Five-a-side pitch at Cronmans väg in Rosengård opened by Zlatan in 2007 (Wikidata Q4992453, 4 sitelinks); no named OSM feature found, and the coordinates are approximate.

notes: Malmö stadion (relation/53037, in landmarks.json) has been demolished: demolition began Nov 2025 and malmo.se says it is finished, with a new 8,000-seat athletics/football stadium being built on the site, due around 2028/29 (https://malmo.se/stadion). Remove it from the game or rename it when the new one opens. Stadionområdet (Wikidata Q7596359) is the cluster that Eleda Stadion, Isstadion, Baltiska hallen, Kombihallen and Atleticum all sit in; residents say 'vid Stadion', so you could treat it as an area instead. Eleda Stadion is the same place as Wikivoyage's 'Swedbank Stadion'. Jägersro is in the game as 'Jägersro travbana' but the long list does not flag it inGame. No 'Malmö Golfhall' exists in OSM; Malmö Indoor Golf in Hyllie is probably it. Malmö Burlöv GK sits on the Malmö/Burlöv border and Malmö City GK Kvarnbybanan is in Malmö (Kvarnby). The other golf clubs (Vallgården, Vellinge, Rönnebäck, Sofiedal) are outside Malmö and dropped. Heleneholms IP and Rosengård norra IP are real but neighbourhood-level, so they are in everything. Bryggeriet and Hyllie Sportcenter are borderline core.
